description: Development scenarios based on official postings checked 2026-11-15. Job text is a short paraphrase, not the full posting. Resumes and expected labels are AI-authored, not human validation. Availability can change.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer Intern - Summer 2027 (USA)
jobs.availability: Official page showed Apply now and ongoing applications on check date.
jobs.job_description:
Software Development Engineer Intern
Requirements
Programming in a general-purpose language such as Python, Java, or C++.
Data structures, algorithms, or object-oriented design.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools.
Design, test, build, and deploy reliable software.
Preferred skills
Cloud platforms, databases, and version control.
Communicate technical decisions and review code.
Qualifications
STEM degree enrollment with graduation between October 2027 and September 2029.
Availability for a full-time twelve-week in-person internship.

jobs.title: NVIDIA 2027 Internships: Deep Learning
jobs.availability: Official indexed posting stated ongoing applications and an existing vacancy; a talent-pool posting across teams.
jobs.job_description:
Deep Learning Intern
Requirements
Develop deep learning algorithms for GPU performance.
Build and optimize deep learning frameworks and libraries.
Contribute to PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
Depending on team, programming knowledge may include Python, C++, and CUDA.
Relevant coursework may cover linear algebra, numerical methods, computer vision, and computer architecture.
Qualifications
Remain enrolled in a relevant BS, MS, or PhD program throughout a twelve-week internship.
Include expected graduation month and year on the resume.

jobs.title: Product Manager Intern - Poland

Product Manager Intern
Requirements

Analyze problems and identify process improvements.
Collaborate and communicate with teammates.
Qualifications
Fluent Polish and advanced English.
Penultimate or final year in engineering, project management, business management, or a related degree.
Available for three to six months full time in Warsaw, starting January through September 2027.
Have permission to work in Poland.
